t: What he said about overdoing it
a: إِنَّ الدِّينَ يُسْرٌ، وَلَنْ يُشَادَّ الدِّينَ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ غَلَبَهُ، فَسَدِّدُوا وَقَارِبُوا وَأَبْشِرُوا، وَاسْتَعِينُوا بِالْغَدْوَةِ وَالرَّوْحَةِ وَشَىْءٍ مِنَ الدُّلْجَةِ
p: Inna-d-dīna yusr, wa lan yushādda-d-dīna aḥadun illā ghalabah. Fa-saddidū wa qāribū wa abshirū, wa-staʿīnū bi-l-ghadwati wa-r-rawḥati wa shayʾin mina-d-duljah
m: This religion is ease. No one makes it hard on himself without it overcoming him. So aim straight, keep close to the mark, take the good news, and get help from the early morning, the late afternoon, and a little of the night.
